title: AXM source ledger
description: The set of sources that AXM primitives may cite. Every primitive's source_basis.source_id must resolve to an entry here. The anti-laundering rule: a source of kind 'model_synthesis' MUST name its author model — model-authored material is compile-time input, never runtime authority (AXM Genesis paper, section 8.3).

kind.description: model_synthesis = authored by a language model; it MUST carry an 'author' field naming the model.

author.description: Required when kind == model_synthesis: the model that authored it (e.g. gpt-5.5-high, gpt-4o).

basis_class.description: How much authority the source itself carries. model_synthesis sources are basis_class 'synthesis'.
